=segments.text:
id: CH10
book: 3
title: Shadow Returns (The Second Coming) | Phase 1: The Shadow Returns

timeline_anchors:
  - Year 10,500 M1 D1: Crimson Citadel (orbital return + tribal fragmentation readout)
  - Year 10,500 M2 D14: Genesis Chambers (Gruulith production + deployment order)
  - Year 10,500 M3 D7: Singing Peaks (Ash Giant territory attacked)

pov_modes:
  - Anunnaki strategy (Eduhauana)
  - Anunnaki bioengineering (Ninurta)
  - Giant frontline (Korrhan)

narrative_intent:
  Start Second Coming by converting the Sundering from “whispers” into “pressure,” introducing engineered suppression species and forcing isolated tribes to beg for unity.

world_state_changes:
  - Queen confirms Sundering success via Needle sensor analysis (measurable cohesion degradation).
  - Suppression assets introduced: Gruulith (deployed first), Dregans + Brajor in pipeline.
  - Ash Giants suffer extermination-style assault; isolation doctrine breaks; help-request goes out.

primary_conflicts:
  - Divided house vs coordinated extermination.
  - Fighting an enemy with no negotiable consciousness (Gruulith as void wall).
  - Pride vs survival (first real crack in isolationist identity).

entities_introduced_or_activated:
  - Ninurta (Overseer bioengineer)
  - Gruulith (engineered stone killers, minimal cognition)
  - Korrhan (Ash Giant leader in Singing Peaks)

mechanics_seeds:
  - Fragmentation Dashboard: numeric “cohesion %” per lineage drives diplomacy difficulty.
  - Creature Wave System: staged deployments (entry-level assets first, then escalation).
  - Camouflage Threat: enemies indistinguishable from terrain until aggro.
  - SOS Harmonic: long-range kha message as a “call alliance” mechanic with political cost.

continuity_flags:
  - Define “Ash Giants” as distinct from prior burnt-red desert lineage (they read like a separate faction here).
  - Track what triggers the Queen’s audit of Brajor behavior (future consequence lever).
